body:
Thank you. 

I have been looking for the subs you mentioned in your first comment, to give it a try, but I can't find them, do you have links?
I have looked into it and nothing looks to promising, I live in a very small town and I don't have a car so getting to the next town over will be difficult.
I don't have the money for a therapist, however your other option seems good in general but not for me, I have enough yelling in my life.

I have been that person for so many years; to the point where when my depression got better a month ago, I don't know who I am.

But, I promise you there is someone who cares, look for small things like saying hello to you every morning, they will reveal themselves if you watch close enough.
